name: Eat All You Can
description: Enjoy an unlimited eat-all-you-can dining experience at a partner restaurant, featuring a wide selection of local and international dishes.
terms: Valid for dine-in only. Advance reservation may be required. Not valid during holidays or peak hours.

name: Staycation for 2
description: Enjoy a relaxing overnight staycation for two at a partner hotel or resort, complete with breakfast and amenities.
terms: Subject to room availability. Advance booking required. Blackout dates may apply.

name: Android Phone

terms: Model subject to stock availability. Non-transferable. Coordinate with admin for claim details.

name: Macbook

terms: Model subject to stock availability. Non-transferable. Coordinate with admin for claim details.

terms: Unit subject to stock and dealer availability. Non-transferable. Additional documentation may be required for registration.

terms: Unit subject to stock and dealer availability. Non-transferable. Additional documentation required for registration and transfer of ownership.

name: SUV Car

terms: Unit subject to stock and dealer availability. Non-transferable. Additional documentation required for registration and transfer of ownership.

terms: Subject to property availability and developer terms. Additional legal documentation required. Coordinate with admin for full details.
